item.title: 4 Fatality Indiana Truck Crash Exposes Chameleon Carrier Network, Again.
item.description: On Tuesday afternoon, a 30-year-old truck driver from Philadelphia named Bekzhan Beishekeev failed to stop for slowed traffic on State Road 67 in Jay County, Indiana. He swerved into oncoming traffic and killed four Amish men, a father, two of his sons, and a family friend. The post 4 Fatality Indiana Truck Crash Exposes Chameleon Carrier Network, Again. appeared first on FreightWaves.
